'''Biomedical cybernetics''' investigates [[signal processing]], [[decision making]] and control structures in living [[organism]]s. Applications of this research field are in [[biology]], [[ecology]] and [[health sciences]].

==Fields==
* [[Biological cybernetics]]
* [[Medical cybernetics]]

==Methods==
* [[Connectionism]]
* [[Decision theory]]
* [[Information theory]]
* [[Systeomics]]
* [[Systems theory]]
